note: MOD_PLAN.md section 6 (fork lead, LEADS.md Part H Indigoshores 12d7cde5 / 0c398d60): STRATA_PF_F16_VAR_BM / STRATA_MOE_MAX_BM, half-tile (32 token rows) work items in the F16 prompt-expert kernels (moe_f16_common.cuh work_item, moe_tile_rule.hpp). Default off, byte-identical unset. The F16 kernels need STRATA_PF_F16=1 (on by default on gfx1151 only, not on gfx1100), so the base arm is f16 (PF_F16=1) and the three arms differ from it in the tile width only: var-bm = half tiles at <= 8 rows an expert on average, var-bm-16 at <= 16, max-bm32 always. The token columns of the WMMA are independent, so the output must match the f16 arm bit for bit (drift_check, text equal); int8 is the reference arm without PF_F16 (rounding differs from F16, information only). Prompt tok/s on short / edit (100-1000 token prompts, the target) and long1k. The engine was not built when this spec was written. Stop pancake.service first. Run at screen, then confirm.
